reviews.title: Blocked every app except for the one I specified
reviews.text: Overall, the app is quite good, and very useful. I’ve been able to reduce my screentime by about 50% just in the last few weeks of using it. Today, however, the app blocked all of my apps until midnight (including UseLess itself) EXCEPT for the one that I wanted it to block, Instagram. I never indicated that I wanted to impose this limit. I’ve tried deleting the app, but the restrictions remain and there’s no way to turn them off in the Screentime settings. This is a serious bug, and it’s making me not want to redownload the app. Please address this.

Who is making these decisions???

Please fix this!  I bought the one year subscription for me and my daughter and feel like I wasted my money!

reviews.title: Uses Psychological tricks to scam you
reviews.text: This app uses psychological tricks on you to try to get you to grow their platform. They make you go through a really long onboarding and hit you with a paywall at the end so you sunk cost fallacy and pay them. Additionally they ask for a rating in the onboarding so most of these ratings are farmed and faked since you don’t even use the app when they ask (they also ask for it before the paywall). On top of all of that I PAID for the app and it is buggy as hell clearly AI Coded money grab.
